blocking_findings.summary: Workspace lint commands leave all TypeScript outside the ESLint configuration (backend/package.json:9): npm workspace scripts run from the workspace directory, but this command supplies `../eslint.config.mjs` through `--config`.

t5-c1: backend and contract have ESLint + Prettier config and lint / format:check scripts that run clean; the pre-existing vendored source is excluded from FORMAT checking via a .prettierignore listing those exact files and ledgered as debt (D-0006), while tools/, the config files this task itself adds, and all newly written code are format-checked (executable MJS also linted), the harness-owned .github workflows are excluded because forge upgrade re-vendors them, and .envrc is validated semantically by the guard test rather than by ESLint or Prettier

t5-c3: FACTORY_QUALITY_CMD covers every workspace that exists at this point (backend + contract) and product CI runs the equivalent aggregate on every push; the frontend is added by frontend-foundation

non_blocking_findings.summary: Guard omits the structural build aliases from its pinned command graph (tools/quality-gate.test.mjs:47): `expectedScripts` pins `build`, which delegates to `build:contract` and `build:backend`, but does not pin either alias.
